payout_quote: To be eligible for this offer, click Apply Online or Open at a Branch from this page, so that the promotion code is claimed at time of account opening. This offer is only available to applicants residing in Alabama, Arkansas, Colorado, Florida, Georgia, Illinois, Indiana, Kentucky, Louisiana, Michigan, Minnesota, Mississippi, Missouri, North Carolina, Ohio, Oklahoma, Pennsylvania, South Carolina, Tennessee, Texas, West Virginia, and Wisconsin. Cash Bonus Offer. To qualify for a $400 cash bonus, new business checking customer is required to do ALL of the following: 1) Open a new Huntington Unlimited Business Checking, Unlimited Plus Business Checking, Business Analyzed, Non Profit Analyzed, or Non Profit Interest Checking account by October 14, 2026. 2) Make total new money deposits of $5,000 or more within sixty (60) days of account opening. 3) Maintain an open account status in the eligible checking account for ninety (90) days. To qualify for a $1,000 cash bonus, new business checking customer is required to do ALL of the following: 1) Open a new Huntington Unlimited Plus Business Checking account by October 14, 2026. 2) Make total new money deposits of $20,000 or more within thirty (30) days of account opening and then maintain a daily balance of $20,000 or more for sixty (60) days after meeting the initial deposit requirement. 3) Maintain an open account status in the eligible checking account for ninety (90) days. 'New money' is defined as money that is not currently on deposit in any Huntington account (except maturing business CDs). Account must maintain an open status for at least 90 days before it is eligible for the bonus payment. Account must maintain open status for at least 90 days before it is eligible for the bonus payment. If you opened an Unlimited Business Checking account, your $400 bonus will be deposited into your new checking account within 14 days of meeting the above requirements. If you opened an Unlimited Plus Business Checking account, your $1,000 bonus will be deposited into your new checking account within 14 days of meeting the above requirements. For tax purposes, you will receive a from 1099-INT from us for the cash bonus.
steps: Confirm your business is in an eligible state (22 states listed by Huntington).
Apply online or open at a branch FROM the promo page so the promotion code is claimed at account opening, by October 14, 2026.
For the $400 tier: deposit $5,000+ in new money within 60 days into an eligible business checking account and keep the account open 90 days.
For the $1,000 tier: open Unlimited Plus, deposit $20,000+ in new money within 30 days, maintain a $20,000+ daily balance for 60 days, and keep the account open 90 days.
Receive the bonus once the 90-day open-account requirement is satisfied.
catches: Business customers only - requires a business entity.
Offer available only in 22 listed states.
Large new-money deposits: $5,000 for $400 tier (Unlimited Business Checking), $20,000 for $1,000 tier (Unlimited Plus Business Checking); new money cannot come from another Huntington account.
The $1,000 tier requires maintaining a $20,000+ daily balance for 60 days - a single dip disqualifies you.
Official terms: Account must maintain open status for at least 90 days before it is eligible for the bonus payment.
Official Huntington business fee schedule: Early Account Closing fee of $20.00 if the account closes within 180 days of opening.
Not available to existing Huntington business checking customers or anyone who closed a Huntington checking account within the last 12 months (official terms).
The promo code must be claimed at account opening by starting from the promo page - opening elsewhere forfeits the offer.
Official terms: For tax purposes, you will receive a 1099-INT from us for the cash bonus.
biggest_catch: Business-only with new-money rules, and the $1,000 tier needs $20,000 parked with a $20K daily minimum for 60 days; existing Huntington business customers are excluded.
